data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gadros' meaning 'a fence, a wall, a fortification'. In the New Testament, Gaderim is mentioned in Matthew 21:12 as one of the cities in which Jesus overthrew the merchants and the money changers. The name Gader carries the meaning “Fence, Wall” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gader usually hope their child will grow to embody fence, wall and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gader total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
